name: Hime-sama Gomeirei o!
source:
The main character is an average student. But one day, a woman knight and two princesses suddenly transfer to his school and he is told to take care of them...

As a matter of fact, the princesses have a secret. There is a traditional custom in their country that the more beautiful breasts they have, the more they are admired. There is also a legend, "the country prospers by beautiful breats taken care of the soldier in the east." The princesses came to his town to look for the "soldier" and he is the one, according to them. 

How can he make their breasts beautiful? But he, who loves breasts, is delighted to be chosen. His happy school life now begins...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角是一名普通学生。然而有一天，一名女骑士和两名公主突然转学到他的学校，他被告知要照顾他们……

事实上，公主们有一个秘密。他们国家有一个传统习俗，就是胸部越美丽，越受人羡慕。还有一个传说：“东边兵养美乳，国家兴盛”。公主们来到他的小镇寻找“士兵”，据她们说，他就是那个人。

怎样才能让她们的胸部变得美丽呢？但热爱乳房的他很高兴被选中。他快乐的学校生活现在开始了……
